source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Ερμογένης, Εξπέδιτος, Αριστόνικος, Ρούφος και Γαλατάς οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole body of the page is one sentence: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο και το μαρτύριο των Αγίων» — we have no details of the life and the martyrdom of the saints. It heads each of the five separately as ο Μάρτυρας, gives no century, no emperor, no city, no manner of death, no relic, no couplet and no hymn. What it does print under three of the names are classical glosses — an Athenian philosopher for Hermogenes, a pupil of the astronomer Aristarchus for Aristonicus — and those are the page's notes on the names, not on these men. Five people are named and enumerated, so this corpus makes one folder for each.
